title: Fresh Step brings a little luxury to the litter aisle
summary: Fresh Step’s Fleur de Purr brings fine-fragrance-inspired scents and trusted odor control to cat litter, turning an everyday essential into a small luxury.
body_markdown:
[Younger consumers are embracing “little treat culture,”](https://www.circana.com/post/little-treats-statistics-trends) looking for small ways to bring enjoyment and a sense of indulgence to everyday life. **Fresh Step saw that behavior taking hold across categories such as beauty, fragrance and food and identified an opportunity to bring the same mindset to an everyday essential: cat litter.**


**The opportunity:** Cat litter has traditionally focused on function, including odor control, clumping, dust and cleanup. Fleur de Purr extends the idea of the everyday “little treat” to the litter aisle, pairing the performance cat parents expect from Fresh Step with sophisticated fragrance inspired by prestige beauty and home fragrance. Rather than asking consumers to choose between performance and experience, Fleur de Purr delivers both.
